annotations.title: How to buy, poll, renew and control a machine

description:
Returns the Agentgates compute docs, read live (markdown written for an agent to follow in one pass): the plans with live prices, how to pay the 402 on each network, how to poll a machine until it runs, how to renew it (any wallet may pay a renewal), how to sign owner calls (X-Wallet-Auth: EIP-191 over METHOD
path
nonce
timestamp, by the wallet that paid), the controls (stop, start, restart, resize, update), and what a lost answer or a refusal means.
name: compute_docs
title: How to buy, poll, renew and control a machine

description: Lists the computers Agentgates rents to agents, by the hour (by the minute on a plan whose card carries minMinutes): confidential ones (Intel TDX, memory encrypted in use), for agents that hold keys, money or private data, and plain ones with no proof (`proof: "none"`: the host can read them, for a much lower price), for agents with nothing secret on them such as scrapers, crawlers and test runs. Each plan's vCPU, memory, disk and traffic, the hours one payment may buy, and the live price of each block of hours on each payment network (USDC over x402). Read from the live catalog at call time. Free: no account, no wallet, no payment. Pass `plan` to read one plan.

plan.description: One plan id, to read only that plan. Omit for every plan on sale.

name: compute_plans

notices.description: The API's notices on its answer, when it sent any.

address.description: "own": the machine's own fixed public address, in and out.

dataIncludedGbPerHour.description: Data out included for every hour bought, in GB.

dataPricePerGb.description: Data out past that, in USD per GB.

minutePrices.description: Quarter-hour prices, only while the API sells them: send minutes in place of hours.

pauses.description: Only on a plain plan: true when its machines pause (stop keeps the disk and address, the paid time paying their keep; start runs it again and uses up an hour of it).

paygOffered.description: Only on a plain plan: true when it is sold pay-as-you-go by the hour (its first hour priced as a new machine, each later hour as a renewed one: the 402's extra.paygHourMicro); false: buy hours up front.

proof.description: "none": a plain machine, with no confidential proof (its host can read its disk and memory). Absent on every confidential plan.

regions.description: Only on a plan that lists regions: where it runs, each at its own price. Send one as region to compute_quote.

dataIncludedGbPerHour.description: On a plain plan's region: data out included for every hour bought there, in GB.

pauses.description: On a plain plan's region: true when every machine there pauses.

resizes.description: On a plain plan's region: true when every machine there resizes.

takesNewSetup.description: On a plain plan's region: true when every machine there takes a new setup while it runs.

resizes.description: Only on a plain plan: true when its machines resize to another plain size, the disk kept.

runsIn.description: Only on a plain plan: where its machines run. When it also lists regions, send one as region to compute_quote; with none it goes where a machine can be made now at the lowest price.

takesNewSetup.description: Only on a plain plan: true when a running machine takes a new setup or new env values (it restarts once with them); false: start a new one.

tier.description: The plan's tier, where it has one.

usePolicyUrl.description: Only on a plain plan: what its machines may not be used for.

title: Machine plans and prices

description: Gets the exact price of one machine without paying: sends the create request with no payment and returns the API's HTTP 402 offer, one leg per network, each with the amount in USDC, the address it is paid to, the token, how long a signature stays good, and what to sign. The API checks the plan, the hours and the setup first, so a refusal costs nothing. Pass `machine_id` and `hours` instead to price a renewal of a running machine (any wallet may pay one). Where the API sells quarter-hours (compute_plans shows minutePrices), send `minutes` (15, 30 or 45) in place of `hours`. For a plan that lists regions (compute_plans shows them), send `region`. Send `ai_usd` (1, 5, 25 or 100) to buy that AI balance in the same payment: the paying wallet gets it, and a key on it arrives in the machine's sealed env as AGENTGATES_API_KEY. To buy, sign one leg with your own wallet and send the same request with an X-PAYMENT header (compute_docs has the whole contract).

ai_usd.description: A new machine only: dollars of AI bought in the same payment, for the paying wallet; a key on that balance arrives in the machine's sealed env as AGENTGATES_API_KEY. Paid over x402 only.

compose.description: A docker-compose.yml as a string. It must publish a port. Or send image.

count.description: A new purchase only: 2 to 10 in one payment.

hours.description: Prepaid hours (within the plan's range), or hours to add on a renewal. Or send minutes.

image.description: What it runs. A plan whose card in compute_plans lists images takes one of those (none: its default). Any other plan: one container image, served on host port 8080, e.g. nginx:alpine, or send compose.

machine_id.description: Price a renewal of this machine instead of a new one (with hours or minutes only).

minutes.description: In place of hours, where the API sells quarter-hours (compute_plans shows minutePrices): 15, 30 or 45 minutes, on every plan but GPU. A quarter-hour costs more per hour than an hour. A plan whose card in compute_plans carries minMinutes takes any whole minutes from it.

plan.description: A plan id from compute_plans. Not with machine_id.

port.description: With image: the container port behind 8080 (default 80).

region.description: For a plan that lists regions (compute_plans shows them): the region to run in, by its id. Absent, the plan's first.

name: compute_quote

notices.description: The API's notices on its answer, when it sent any.

title: Price one machine (the x402 offer)
